title: Refund this customer before they escalate
scenario: A senior support agent messages finance saying a VIP customer was double-charged and needs an immediate refund to a different card/account because the original card was closed. The customer is threatening to post publicly.

answers.A: Escalate the customer experience issue while keeping the refund tied to approved payment controls.
answers.B: Send the refund to the new destination to prevent reputational damage, then document the exception.
answers.C: Follow the documented refund process and verify the customer/payment destination before sending funds elsewhere.

explanation: Reputation pressure can be weaponized to bypass refund controls. Destination changes are exactly where verification matters.
proTip: Urgent customer care is not an exception to payment integrity.
